cards.headline:
E Ink OATs가
사물을 가상 펫으로
cards.body: Carnegie Mellon 학생의 OATs는 사물에 성격을 입혀 습관을 돕는다.
cards.mini_headline: 일상 사물을 위한 E Ink 펫

blocks.x: 식물에 물 주는 걸 깜빡했다. 잎이 누렇게 변하는 대신, 작은 화면 속 귀여운 식물 모양 펫이 슬프고 풀 죽은 얼굴을 한다. OATs, 즉 Object Agent Twins의 발상이다. 집 안의 평범한 사물과 짝을 이루도록 만든 마이크로 에이전트 AI 아바타가 작은 E Ink 디스플레이에 뜬다. 만든 사람은 Carnegie Mellon Future Interfaces Group의 박사(PhD) 과정 다섯 해째 학생 Daehwa Kim이다. Kim은 Detroit에서 열린 ACM Symposium on User Interface Software and Technology에서 이 프로젝트를 발표해 Honorable Mention 상 두 개를 받았다.

OATs는 수분, 온도, 습도, 조도, 재실 여부, 움직임을 감지하는 센서에 E Ink 디스플레이를 붙인 구조다(메인 모듈은 약 $20). 스프라이트는 Google Gemini의 Nano Banana가 그리고, 웹 포털은 사물의 이름과 설명을 보고 “Positive”와 “Negative” 행동을 만든다. 스케이트보드를 며칠 내버려 두면 아바타가 슬프고 외로워 보이고, 올라타면 기뻐한다.
배터리는 사흘에서 나흘 정도밖에 못 가고, 소음 센서를 켜면 하루 남짓이라 아직은 개념 증명 단계다. 테스터들은 OATs로 사물이 쓰이는지 확인했고, 작동 중인 3D 프린터 근처에 온 사람에게 경고를 띄웠다. 꾸준한 운동을 독려한 덤벨처럼 습관을 기록하기도 했다.
데모는 AI 의인화 논쟁도 불러왔다. 그래서 OATs의 상호작용은 E Ink 디스플레이 위 감정 표현으로 한정된다. Kim은 “의인화는 사람들의 행동 변화를 돕는 것처럼 어떤 면에서는 매우 유용할 수 있다”며 “하지만 이를 남용하지 않도록 분명히 조심해야 한다”고 말한다.

en.headline:
E Ink OATs turn objects
into needy virtual pets
en.body: A Carnegie Mellon student's E Ink OATs give plants, skateboards, and dumbbells personalities to nudge better habits.
en.mini_headline: E Ink pets for everyday objects

blocks.x: You forgot to water the plant. Instead of yellowing leaves, you see a cute plant-shaped pet on a tiny screen, looking sad and dejected. That's the idea behind OATs, or Object Agent Twins—micro-agent AI avatars on tiny E Ink displays designed to pair with everyday household objects, created by Daehwa Kim, a fifth-year PhD student in Carnegie Mellon's Future Interfaces Group. Kim presented the project at the ACM Symposium on User Interface Software and Technology in Detroit and earned two Honorable Mention awards.

OATs have an E Ink display connected to sensors that track moisture, temperature, humidity, light, occupancy, and motion (around $20 for the main module). The sprites are created with Google Gemini's Nano Banana, and a web portal generates “Positive” and “Negative” behaviors from your object's name and description. Leave a skateboard unused for days and the avatar looks sad and lonely; hop on and it's happy.

Battery life is short—around three to four days, or a day with the sound-level sensor—so this is more of a proof of concept. Testers used OATs to see whether an object is being used, to warn people near a running 3D printer, and to track habits, like a dumbbell that encouraged regular exercise.

The demo also sparked discussion about anthropomorphizing AI, which is why OATs' interactions are limited to expressive emotions on the E Ink display. “Anthropomorphism can be very useful in certain ways, like helping people to change their behaviors,” Kim says, “but we should definitely be careful not to abuse this.”

ja.headline:
E Ink OATsが
物を仮想ペットに変える
ja.body: Carnegie Mellonの学生によるOATsは、物に性格を与え習慣を後押しする。
ja.mini_headline: 日用品のためのE Inkペット

zh.headline:
E Ink OATs
让物件变成黏人的虚拟宠物
zh.body: Carnegie Mellon学生的OATs为植物、滑板和哑铃赋予个性，促成好习惯。
zh.mini_headline: 为日常物件打造的E Ink宠物

blocks.x: 你忘了给植物浇水。映入眼帘的不是发黄的叶子，而是小屏幕上一只可爱的植物造型宠物，看起来又难过又沮丧。这就是OATs（Object Agent Twins）背后的构想：运行在小型E Ink显示屏上的微型智能体AI化身，专为与日常家居物件配对而设计，由Carnegie Mellon的Future Interfaces Group五年级PhD学生Daehwa Kim打造。Kim在Detroit举行的ACM Symposium on User Interface Software and Technology上展示了这一项目，并获得两项Honorable Mention奖。
OATs的E Ink显示屏连接着可监测水分、温度、湿度、光照、占用状态和运动的传感器（主模块约$20）。精灵形象由Google Gemini的Nano Banana生成，网页门户会根据物件的名称和描述生成“Positive”和“Negative”行为。滑板几天不用，化身就显得悲伤孤独；踩上去，它就开心起来。
电池续航很短——约三到四天，若启用声级传感器则只有一天左右——因此它更像是一个概念验证。测试者用OATs查看物件是否在被使用、提醒运行中的3D打印机附近的人，以及追踪习惯，比如一只鼓励规律锻炼的哑铃。
这次演示也引发了关于AI拟人化的讨论，这也是OATs的交互仅限于E Ink显示屏上情绪表达的原因。“拟人化在某些方面可能非常有用，比如帮助人们改变行为，”Kim说，“但我们绝对应该小心，不要滥用这一点。”

es.headline:
Los E Ink OATs convierten
objetos en mascotas exigentes
es.body: Los E Ink OATs de un alumno de Carnegie Mellon dan personalidad a plantas, patinetas y pesas para mejorar hábitos.
es.mini_headline: Mascotas E Ink para objetos cotidianos

blocks.x: Olvidaste regar la planta. En lugar de hojas amarillentas, ves en una pequeña pantalla una simpática mascota con forma de planta, triste y abatida. Esa es la idea detrás de OATs, u Object Agent Twins: avatares de AI con microagentes en pequeñas pantallas E Ink, diseñados para acompañar objetos cotidianos del hogar y creados por Daehwa Kim, estudiante de quinto año de PhD en el Future Interfaces Group de Carnegie Mellon. Kim presentó el proyecto en el ACM Symposium on User Interface Software and Technology en Detroit y obtuvo dos premios Honorable Mention.

Los OATs tienen una pantalla E Ink conectada a sensores que registran humedad, temperatura, humedad relativa, luz, ocupación y movimiento (unos $20 por el módulo principal). Los sprites se crean con Nano Banana de Google Gemini, y un portal web genera comportamientos “Positive” y “Negative” a partir del nombre y la descripción del objeto. Si una patineta pasa días sin usarse, el avatar se ve triste y solo; si te subes, se pone contento.

La batería dura poco —entre tres y cuatro días, o un día con el sensor de nivel sonoro—, así que es más bien una prueba de concepto. Quienes lo probaron usaron OATs para saber si un objeto se está usando, advertir a quienes están cerca de una impresora 3D en marcha y seguir hábitos, como una mancuerna que animaba a hacer ejercicio con regularidad.

La demostración también abrió el debate sobre la antropomorfización de la AI, y por eso las interacciones de los OATs se limitan a emociones expresivas en la pantalla E Ink. “La antropomorfización puede ser muy útil en ciertos aspectos, como ayudar a las personas a cambiar sus conductas”, dice Kim, “pero sin duda debemos tener cuidado de no abusar de esto”.

blocks.x: Xiaomi 18 Pro 시리즈의 후면 디스플레이는 이번엔 정말 쓸모가 있을지도 모른다.

후면 디스플레이를 단 폰을 내놓은 회사는 손에 꼽고, 솔직히 대부분은 별 쓸모가 없었다. Xiaomi는 Xiaomi 18 Pro와 Xiaomi 18 Pro Max의 후면 디스플레이로 판을 뒤집으려 한다. 회사 설명으로는 이 화면이 Google Maps, YouTube Music, Spotify를 지원하고, 깔끔한 GenAI 통합 덕에 수많은 추가 앱도 돌린다.
소식은 GSMArena가 전했고, Xiaomi Group의 VP & CMO인 Xu Fei가 X에 올려 온 AMA 영상이 출처다. 아직 못 봤다면, Xiaomi 18 Pro 시리즈 뒷면의 카메라 섬은 Galaxy Z Flip 8이나 Motorola Razr 시리즈 같은 플립형 폴더블의 커버 화면을 닮았다. 풀컬러 터치스크린에 해상도도 꽤 높다.

en.headline:
Xiaomi 18 Pro rear screen
runs custom GenAI apps
en.body: The Xiaomi 18 Pro series' rear display supports Google apps, Spotify, and even custom GenAI apps.

blocks.x: The Xiaomi 18 Pro series’ rear displays might actually be useful, after all.

Only a few companies have debuted phones with rear displays, and, quite frankly, most of them have been fairly useless. Xiaomi is hoping to turn all that around with the Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max’s rear display, which the company says supports Google Maps, YouTube Music, Spotify, and lots of additional apps via a nifty GenAI integration.

The news comes via GSMArena and builds on the AMA videos Xu Fei, VP & CMO of the Xiaomi Group, has been posting on X. If you haven’t seen it yet, the camera island on the back of the Xiaomi 18 Pro series looks similar to the cover screen on a flip-style foldable like the Galaxy Z Flip 8 or Motorola Razr series. It’s a full-color touchscreen and has impressively high resolution.

YouTube Music and Spotify will feature prominent play/pause and skip buttons, plus the artwork and name of the song playing. Google Maps will give you a navigation progress indicator, plus the next upcoming direction.

In addition to official integration, Xiaomi is letting users create their own rear display apps using a built-in GenAI app creation tool. Just describe what you want, and the onboard AI will create the app for you. It looks quite handy and should help solve the “useless” problem that prior rear displays have faced. The Xiaomi 18 Pro series will debut globally.

blocks.x: Xiaomi 18 Proシリーズの背面ディスプレイは、結局のところ本当に役立つものになるかもしれない。

背面ディスプレイ付きのスマートフォンを出したメーカーはわずかで、率直に言えば、その大半はほとんど役に立たなかった。XiaomiはXiaomi 18 ProとXiaomi 18 Pro Maxの背面ディスプレイでその状況を覆そうとしている。同社によると、この画面はGoogle Maps、YouTube Music、Spotifyに対応し、気の利いたGenAI統合によって多くの追加アプリも使えるという。

このニュースはGSMArena経由で伝えられたもので、Xiaomi GroupのVP & CMOであるXu FeiがXに投稿してきたAMA動画に基づいている。まだ見ていない人のために言えば、Xiaomi 18 Proシリーズ背面のカメラアイランドは、Galaxy Z Flip 8やMotorola Razrシリーズのような縦折りフォルダブルのカバー画面に似ている。フルカラーのタッチスクリーンで、解像度も見事に高い。
YouTube MusicとSpotifyでは、再生/一時停止とスキップのボタンが大きく表示され、再生中の曲のアートワークと曲名も出る。Google Mapsはナビの進行状況表示と、次の進路案内を示す。

es.headline:
Xiaomi 18 Pro: su pantalla
trasera ejecuta apps GenAI
es.body: La pantalla trasera de la serie Xiaomi 18 Pro admite apps de Google, Spotify e incluso apps GenAI personalizadas.
es.mini_headline: La pantalla trasera de Xiaomi ejecuta GenAI

blocks.x: Las pantallas traseras de la serie Xiaomi 18 Pro podrían, después de todo, resultar útiles.

Solo unas pocas empresas han lanzado teléfonos con pantalla trasera y, francamente, la mayoría han sido bastante inútiles. Xiaomi espera darle la vuelta a eso con la pantalla trasera del Xiaomi 18 Pro y el Xiaomi 18 Pro Max, que según la compañía admite Google Maps, YouTube Music, Spotify y muchas otras apps gracias a una ingeniosa integración GenAI.

La noticia llega a través de GSMArena y se basa en los videos AMA que Xu Fei, VP & CMO de Xiaomi Group, ha publicado en X. Si aún no la has visto, la isla de cámaras en la parte trasera de la serie Xiaomi 18 Pro se parece a la pantalla exterior de un plegable tipo concha como el Galaxy Z Flip 8 o la serie Motorola Razr. Es una pantalla táctil a todo color y tiene una resolución notablemente alta.

YouTube Music y Spotify mostrarán botones destacados de reproducir/pausar y saltar, además de la carátula y el nombre de la canción en curso. Google Maps ofrecerá un indicador de progreso de la navegación y la siguiente indicación de ruta.

Además de la integración oficial, Xiaomi permite a los usuarios crear sus propias apps para la pantalla trasera con una herramienta integrada de creación de apps GenAI. Basta con describir lo que se quiere y la AI del dispositivo crea la app. Parece bastante práctica y debería ayudar a resolver el problema de “inutilidad” que han arrastrado las pantallas traseras anteriores. La serie Xiaomi 18 Pro se lanzará a nivel global.

cards.headline:
tvOS 27.2.1 배포
4K 구형도 Siri AI
cards.body: tvOS 27.2.1은 2·3세대 Apple TV 4K 에 Siri AI를 들였다.

blocks.x: Apple이 오늘 tvOS 27.2.1을 배포했다. 9월에 나온 tvOS 27 운영체제의 업데이트다. tvOS 27.2.1은 Apple이 tvOS 27.2를 낸 지 세 주 가까이 만에 나왔다.
tvOS 27.2.1로 2세대와 3세대 Apple TV 4K 모델에서도 Siri AI를 쓸 수 있게 됐다. 업데이트 자체는 tvOS 27을 지원하는 모든 Apple TV 4K 모델이 받을 수 있다.
Apple은 4세대 Apple TV 4K 를 공개하면서 Apple TV용 Siri AI를 발표했다. 최신 셋톱박스는 별도 tvOS 27.2 빌드로 Siri AI가 켜지지만, 구형 Apple TV 4K 모델은 tvOS 27.2.1 업데이트를 받아야 쓸 수 있다.
Siri AI는 Apple이 올해 초 선보인, 한층 똑똑하고 유능해진 Siri다. Siri AI는 콘텐츠를 틀고, 개인 맥락에 맞춰 제안하고, 일반 상식 질문에 답하며, 작업도 처리한다.
Apple TV에서 Siri AI를 쓰려면 Apple Intelligence-compatible iOS 기기, 즉 iPhone 15 Pro 이후 모델과 페어링해야 한다.
Apple TV 사용자는 설정(Settings) > 시스템(System) > 소프트웨어 업데이트(Software Update)에서 tvOS 27.2.1을 받을 수 있다. Apple은 HomePod와 HomePod mini용 HomePod Software 27.2.1 업데이트도 함께 내놓았다.

en.headline:
tvOS 27.2.1 brings Siri AI
to older Apple TV 4K models
en.body: Apple's tvOS 27.2.1 brings Siri AI to the 2nd- and 3rd-generation Apple TV 4K, nearly three weeks after tvOS 27.2.
en.mini_headline: Siri AI reaches older Apple TVs

blocks.x: Apple today released tvOS 27.2.1, an update to the tvOS 27 operating system that launched in September. tvOS 27.2.1 comes nearly three weeks after Apple released tvOS 27.2.
tvOS 27.2.1 brings Siri AI support to the 2nd- and 3rd-generation Apple TV 4K models, but it is available for all Apple TV 4K models that support tvOS 27.

Apple announced Siri AI for the Apple TV when debuting the 4th-generation Apple TV 4K. A separate tvOS 27.2 build activates Siri AI on the newest set-top box, but the older Apple TV 4K models will need the tvOS 27.2.1 update to get access.

Siri AI is the smarter, more capable version of Siri that Apple introduced earlier this year. Siri AI can play content, draw on personal context to offer suggestions, answer world knowledge questions, and complete tasks.
Using Siri AI on the Apple TV requires a paired Apple Intelligence-compatible iOS device, which includes the iPhone 15 Pro and later.
Apple TV users can download tvOS 27.2.1 by going to Settings > System > Software Update. Apple has also released a new HomePod Software 27.2.1 update for the HomePod and HomePod mini.

a los Apple TV 4K anteriores

blocks.x: SlashVibe는 AI 에이전트용 분리형 컨트롤러를 단 작은 데스크 디스플레이다. 제작진은 이를 구동하는 데스크톱 앱, 펌웨어, 통신 프로토콜, SDK를 오픈소스로 공개한다. Kickstarter 캠페인은 2026년 11월 15일 기준 552명의 후원자에게서 $122,881을 모아 목표액 $10,000를 훌쩍 넘겼고, 12월 10일에 마감한다. Early Bird 후원가는 $189로 소매가 $249보다 $60 싸며, 첫 물량은 2027년 3월부터 출하될 예정이다.

en.headline:
SlashVibe, an open-source
desk controller for AI agents
en.body: SlashVibe, an open-source AI agent desk controller with Node.js and Python SDKs, starts at $189 on Kickstarter.

blocks.cap: SlashVibe V1 held in two hands with agent sessions marked waiting, done and working on its display

blocks.x: SlashVibe is a small desk display with a detachable controller for your AI agents, and its makers are open-sourcing the desktop app, firmware, communication protocol and SDK behind it. The Kickstarter had raised $122,881 against a $10,000 goal from 552 backers as of November 15, 2026, and closes on December 10. Early Bird pledges sit at $189, $60 under the $249 retail price, and the first batch is expected to start shipping in March 2027.

Node.js or Python is all the SlashVibe SDK needs. Your code runs on your computer and streams its interface to SlashVibe. Three hooks ship in the first release: custom screen layouts, button and joystick events, and the text transcribed from your voice.

blocks.cap: SlashVibe SDK example screen tracking API spend against a monthly budget

blocks.x: The hardware has a 3.96-inch LCD, Kailh ultra-low-profile mechanical switches, a two-axis joystick, dual MEMS microphones and a 2W speaker; the controller detaches and talks over 2.4GHz on a 500mAh battery rated for 20 hours.

blocks.cap: SlashVibe display close-up showing agent sessions marked waiting, done and working

blocks.x: Out of the box, SlashVibe works with more than 20 agents and tools on macOS and Windows, including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot CLI and Gemini CLI. Every session shows as running, done or waiting, and approvals happen on the device. Voice input starts recording in under 100 milliseconds and strips filler words. No license or repository has been named yet; the code will be published before shipping.

cards.headline:
HP ZGX Fury puts a GB300
on the desk for $132,000
cards.body: HP's ZGX Fury puts Nvidia GB300 power, 748GB of memory, and 400Gbps networking in a desk-side chassis.

blocks.cap: HP ZGX Fury desktop workstation

blocks.x: HP has introduced an expensive workstation that brings computing hardware previously associated with large-scale AI infrastructure into an office-sized machine. The ZGX Fury G1n combines Nvidia's GB300 Grace Blackwell Ultra processor with LPDDR5X and HBM3e memory: 496GB of system memory and 252GB for graphics, 748GB in total, with a 72-core Arm Neoverse V2 Grace CPU. Selected configurations raise video memory to 276GB, including discrete RTX PRO 2000 and RTX PRO 4000 cards.
HP says the memory can accommodate local adjustment of language models with up to 100 billion parameters, and inference on models reaching one trillion parameters through FP4 quantization.

It uses liquid cooling with a 1,600W Titanium-certified power supply, ships with Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, and an Nvidia ConnectX-8 SuperNIC provides two QSFP112 connections rated at 400Gbps. The enclosure also fits a 5U equipment rack.
The standard configuration costs $132,000; the RTX PRO 2000 option is $133,000 and the RTX PRO 4000 option $136,000.

blocks.x: HP presentó una costosa estación de trabajo que lleva hardware de cómputo antes asociado a la infraestructura de AI a gran escala a una máquina del tamaño de una oficina. El ZGX Fury G1n combina el procesador GB300 Grace Blackwell Ultra de Nvidia con memoria LPDDR5X y HBM3e: 496GB de memoria del sistema y 252GB para gráficos, 748GB en total, con una CPU Arm Neoverse V2 Grace de 72 núcleos. Algunas configuraciones elevan la memoria de video a 276GB, con tarjetas dedicadas RTX PRO 2000 y RTX PRO 4000.

HP afirma que la memoria permite ajustar localmente modelos de lenguaje de hasta 100 billion (cien mil millones) de parámetros, y ejecutar inferencia en modelos de un billón de parámetros mediante cuantización FP4.

Usa refrigeración líquida con una fuente de alimentación Titanium-certified de 1,600W, viene con Ubuntu 24.04 LTS y una Nvidia ConnectX-8 SuperNIC ofrece dos conexiones QSFP112 de 400Gbps. La carcasa también cabe en un rack de equipos de 5U.
La configuración estándar cuesta $132,000; la opción con RTX PRO 2000 cuesta $133,000 y la de RTX PRO 4000, $136,000.

zh.headline:
HP ZGX Fury桌面机
GB300售$132,000
zh.body: HP ZGX Fury把GB300、748GB 内存和400Gbps 网络装进桌边机箱。

blocks.cap: HP ZGX Fury台式工作站

blocks.x: HP推出了一款昂贵的工作站，把以往属于大规模AI基础设施的计算硬件装进办公室大小的机器。ZGX Fury G1n将Nvidia的GB300 Grace Blackwell Ultra处理器与LPDDR5X和HBM3e内存结合：496GB 系统内存加252GB 图形内存，共748GB ，并配备72核Arm Neoverse V2 Grace CPU。部分配置包含独立的RTX PRO 2000和RTX PRO 4000显卡，显存提升至276GB 。
HP表示，这些内存可支持在本地调整参数多达1000亿的语言模型，并能通过FP4量化对参数达一万亿的模型进行推理。
它采用液冷，配备1,600W 的Titanium-certified电源，预装Ubuntu 24.04 LTS，Nvidia ConnectX-8 SuperNIC提供两个速率为400Gbps 的QSFP112接口。机箱也可装入5U 设备机架。
标准配置售价$132,000；RTX PRO 2000选项为$133,000，RTX PRO 4000选项为$136,000。
